# কারেন্ট Koi?

> Community-reported electricity and load-shedding status tracker for Bangladesh. Not an official government or utility app — every report comes from an ordinary visitor, not an official source, and is not verified against real grid data.

## Pages

- [Home](https://karentkoi.live/): Live map and list of community-submitted power outage reports across Bangladesh, filterable by division, district, provider, and status, plus a "nearby outages" panel and outage-timing charts.
- [About](https://karentkoi.live/about): Who built the project and why.

## Notes

- Available in Bengali (default) and English via the language toggle in the header.
- Report data changes continuously as visitors submit and confirm outages; there is no static content beyond the two pages above.
- No user accounts — reports are anonymous, identified only by a hashed cookie used to prevent duplicate confirms.
